title: 第856章 回到洞府第854章 见宗主
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
宁知初沿着主峰的石阶往下走了约莫一刻钟，拐过凌霄峰山腰那条熟悉的小径，便看到了自己那座洞府的轮廓。它在凌霄峰最清净的一隅，背靠一片矮崖，门前有一小片空地，空地旁种着几棵她当年随手插下的灵竹，如今已经长成了密密的一丛，竹叶在风里沙沙作响。洞府有自动护阵维持整洁，哪怕多年无人居住，石阶上依旧干净得没有一片落叶，门扉前的灵草也长得整整齐齐，跟主人从未离开过一样。
她推开院门走进去的时候，有一种时间在这里停住了的错觉。石桌还在原处，石凳的位置也没有变过，角落里那只她以前用来随手插花枝的粗陶瓶还在那里摆着，瓶口落了一层薄薄的灰。一切都和她离开时一模一样，安静、清简、熟悉。
宁知初在院子里站了一会儿，神识自然而然地往外扩了一圈，下意识地扫了扫凌霄峰各处的动向。茶亭那边已经没人了——大师兄果然已经忙起来了。她的神识捕捉到百里楚尧的身影正在凌霄峰主殿那边，面前堆着好几摞玉简，旁边站着两个执事弟子正在一一汇报什么。峰内各类宗门事务、弟子报备、任务统筹、资源清点全都压在他一个人肩上，整个人从头到脚写着忙不过来四个字。
宁知初收回神识摇了摇头，随口感慨了一句：果然当上凌霄峰峰主就彻底清闲不下来了。以前大师兄还能偶尔偷闲煮茶静坐，如今身居其职，大大小小的事情都要亲自过问，真是半点摸鱼的时间都没有。
她语气平平的带着几分无奈又带着几分了然。天玄宗凌霄峰是宗门主峰之一，管辖弟子虽然不算太多但责任最重，百里楚尧为人稳重靠谱执掌峰主之位从来不会敷衍懈怠，所有事情必定亲力亲为自然日日忙碌。宁知初早就习惯了宗门众人各司其职的状态也不多感慨，只是收回神识彻底放空了感知。
这会儿洞府院落里安安静静的，四周无人没有同门路过没有弟子拜访没有公务打扰，是彻底属于她自己的闲暇时间。头顶的天光透过竹叶的缝隙漏下来在石桌上铺了一地碎碎的光斑，偶尔有一两只山鸟从矮崖那边飞过来落在竹枝上叫两声又飞走了。
一路跟着她的两个小伙伴全程安分隐忍半点动静没出。肩头的小玄龟依旧保持着巴掌大小的迷你模样安安静静趴着，一动不动看起来就是一只普通的随身灵宠，在外人眼里毫无存在感，从凌霄峰茶亭到宗主大殿再到这会儿的洞府，全程没人多看它一眼。发髻上的桃木簪更是气息全无彻底隐匿，桃夭夭憋了一路从拜见大师兄到面见宗主全程旁观早就憋坏了。
这会儿察觉到洞府彻底无人，桃夭夭再也忍不住了。微光轻轻一闪，那支温润的桃木簪从宁知初发间脱离，落地时化作一个粉色衣裙的少女。桃夭夭一落地就长长地舒了一口气，原地转了个圈活动了一下筋骨，整个人肉眼可见地鲜活起来了。
憋死我了憋死我了！她拍着胸口感叹道，从茶亭到宗主大殿再走回来这一路上我一个字都没说！大师兄在的时候我忍住了，宗主在的时候我也忍住了，回了洞府我终于能喘口气了！
她立刻凑到宁知初身边，那双大眼睛亮晶晶的满是好奇，叽叽喳喳地开启了疯狂提问模式。从踏入神隐大陆开始她就一直憋着一肚子疑问，这会儿终于能光明正大说话了，语速快得跟竹筒倒豆子似的。
知初！这里就是你的宗门呀？！我一路神识看着只敢悄悄看不敢出声，现在终于能好好逛一逛了！你们宗门也太安静了吧！没有吵闹声没有修士乱跑，和人族城池完全不一样，人家那边叫卖声从早响到晚，你们这边连走路都轻手轻脚的！
宁知初看着她一脸求知欲爆棚对一切都充满好奇的模样忍不住笑了笑，在石桌旁坐下随口回道：宗门本就是清修之地，弟子大多要么闭关要么历练要么练剑，平日里本来就安静。只有坊市和演武场会热闹一些，你要是想看热闹等改天我带你去宗门坊市转一圈。
桃夭夭立刻追问了一连串问题：那你们宗门一共有多少人呀？有没有很严厉的长老动不动就罚人的那种？你们这里的弟子会不会天天卷修炼卷境界卷资源？刚才那个宗主看着好严肃是不是平日里特别凶？还有刚才那个大师兄他人好好性格是不是特别温柔？
一连串问题噼里啪啦地砸出来语速飞快充满新鲜感。她活了一万多年常年待在东华大陆的深山密林偶尔进城逛街但从来没有真正踏入过正统修仙宗门，对宗门的一切制度人员规矩生活模式完全陌生，满眼都是新奇。
宁知初看着她好奇宝宝的模样也不着急休息，耐心十足地摆了摆手：你别急，一个个问，我慢慢跟你说。正好现在没人我把三小只也放出来大家一起唠嗑省得你一个人好奇。
话音落下她心念一动把一直乖乖待在芥子空间里吃瓜围观的三小只全部放了出来。微光闪烁之后小岚只只小青三只小家伙稳稳落地落在院落石桌旁。小岚一出来就蹦了两下扑棱着翅膀把羽毛抖开，深吸了一口院子的空气然后一脸陶醉：终于出来透气啦！一路憋死我了！在空间里虽然舒服但隔着屏障看总觉得隔了一层，还是外面热闹！
只只站在一旁软软地环顾了一圈四周，眼睛里带着怀念的笑意：洞府还是和以前一样很安静很舒服，连那丛灵竹都长高了好多。以前我们经常在竹子底下玩，那时候竹笋才刚冒头呢。
小青依旧沉稳落地之后静静站立目光扫过整个院落微微点了点头没有什么多余的话但周身气息明显比在空间里松弛了一些。
content_en:
Ning Zhichu walked down the stone steps of the main peak for about a quarter of an hour, turned around the familiar path on the mountainside of Lingxiao Peak, and saw the outline of his cave. It is located in the purest corner of Lingxiao Peak, backed by a low cliff, and there is a small open space in front of the door. Next to the open space, there are several spiritual bamboo trees that she randomly planted back then. Now they have grown into a dense clump, and the bamboo leaves are rustling in the wind. The cave has an automatic protective array to keep it clean and tidy. Even if it has been uninhabited for many years, the stone steps are still clean without a fallen leaf, and the spiritual grass in front of the door grows neatly, as if the owner has never left.
When she opened the courtyard door and walked in, she had the illusion that time had stopped here. The stone table is still in place, the position of the stone bench has not changed, and the stoneware vase in the corner where she used to arrange flowers is still there, with a thin layer of ash falling on the mouth of the vase. Everything was exactly the same as when she left, quiet, simple, and familiar.
Ning Zhichu stood in the yard for a while, and his consciousness naturally expanded in a circle, subconsciously scanning the movements of Lingxiao Peak. There is no one at the tea pavilion anymore - the senior brother is indeed busy. Her consciousness captured Baili Chuyao's figure at the main hall of Lingxiao Peak. There were several piles of jade slips in front of him, and two deacon disciples stood next to him and were reporting something one by one. All kinds of sect affairs in the peak, disciple reporting, task coordination, and resource inventory were all placed on his shoulders, and he was overwhelmed from head to toe.
Ning Zhichu withdrew his consciousness and shook his head, sighing casually: Sure enough, once you become the master of Lingxiao Peak, you will never be able to relax at all. In the past, senior brother could occasionally take a break to make tea and sit quietly. Now that he is in his position, he has to personally deal with all matters big and small. He really doesn't have any time to fish.
Her tone was calm, with a bit of helplessness and a bit of understanding. Tianxuan Sect Lingxiao Peak is one of the main peaks of the sect. Although it does not have too many disciples, it has the heaviest responsibility. Baili Chuyao is a stable and reliable person who will never slack off in his position as the peak leader. He must do everything personally and be busy every day. Ning Zhichu had long been accustomed to the state of everyone in the sect performing their respective duties and didn't express much emotion. He just withdrew his consciousness and completely let go of his perception.
At this moment, the courtyard of the Dongfu was quiet and quiet, with no one around, no fellow disciples passing by, no disciples visiting, no official interruptions, it was her own free time. The skylight overhead leaked through the gaps in the bamboo leaves, covering the stone table with scattered light spots. Occasionally, one or two mountain birds flew over from the short cliff and landed on the bamboo branches, calling twice and then flying away.
The two friends who followed her all the way calmly tolerated the slightest movement and did not make any noise. The little black turtle on the shoulder still maintains its palm-sized mini appearance and lies quietly. It looks like an ordinary portable spiritual pet without moving. It has no sense of existence in the eyes of outsiders. From the Lingxiao Peak Tea Pavilion to the Sect Master's Hall and now to the cave, no one gave it a second glance. The peach wood hairpin on her bun completely concealed her breath. Tao Yaoyao had been holding it in and watching the whole process from meeting her senior brother to meeting the sect master.
At this moment, she realized that the cave was completely deserted, and Tao Yaoyao couldn't bear it anymore. With a slight flash of light, the warm peach wood hairpin detached from Ning Zhi's hair and turned into a girl in a pink dress when it landed. Tao Yaoyao let out a long sigh of relief as soon as she landed on the ground. She spun around in a circle and stretched her muscles. Her whole body became visibly alive to the naked eye.
Suffocate me to death. Suffocate me to death! She patted her chest and sighed, "I didn't say a word during the walk from the tea pavilion to the sect master's hall and back!" I endured it when the senior brother was here, and I endured it when the sect master was around. After returning to the cave, I could finally take a breath!
She immediately came to Ning Zhichu's side, her big eyes sparkling with curiosity, and she started chirping into crazy questioning mode. She has been holding back a lot of questions since she stepped into Shenyin Continent. Now she can finallyHe spoke openly and openly, as fast as pouring beans through a bamboo tube.
Know the beginning! Is this your sect? ! I watched with my consciousness all the way and dared to watch quietly without making a sound. Now I can finally take a stroll! Your sect is too quiet! There is no noise and no monks running around. It is completely different from the human city. The people there are shouting from morning to night, but you are even walking lightly here!
Ning Zhichu couldn't help but smile when he saw her expression of eagerness for knowledge and curiosity about everything. He sat down at the stone table and casually replied: "The sect is a place of pure cultivation. Most of the disciples are either in seclusion, practicing or practicing swordsmanship. They are usually quiet on weekdays." Only the market and the martial arts arena will be more lively. If you want to see the excitement, I will take you to Zongmenfang City another day.
Tao Yaoyao immediately asked a series of questions: How many people are there in your sect? Are there any very strict elders who punish people at every turn? Will your disciples here roll up the cultivation volume and realm volume resources every day? The sect leader looked so serious just now. Was he usually very fierce? Also, isn’t that senior brother just now a very kind-hearted person?
A series of questions were rattled out quickly and full of freshness. She has lived for more than 10,000 years and has stayed in the deep mountains and forests of Donghua Continent all year round. She occasionally goes to the city to go shopping, but she has never really stepped into an orthodox immortal cultivation sect. She is completely unfamiliar with all the rules and life styles of the sect's system, personnel, and everything is novel.
Ning Zhichu looked at her curious look at the baby and was not in a hurry to rest. He waved his hand patiently: "Don't be anxious, ask one by one, and I will tell you slowly." It just so happens that there's no one around right now, so I let the three little ones out so we can all chat together so that you don't have to be curious alone.
As soon as she finished speaking, she thought and released all the three little ones who had been obediently staying in the mustard space eating melons and watching. After a flicker of light, Xiaolan, Xiaoqing and three little guys landed steadily beside the stone table in the courtyard. As soon as Xiaolan came out, she jumped twice, fluttered her wings and fluttered her feathers. She took a deep breath of the air in the yard and looked intoxicated: She finally came out for some air! It suffocated me all the way! Although it is comfortable in the space, looking through the barrier, it always feels like there is a layer of separation, and it is still lively outside!
He just stood aside and looked around softly, with a nostalgic smile in his eyes: the cave was still as quiet and comfortable as before, and even the clump of spiritual bamboos had grown a lot taller. We used to play under the bamboo, and the bamboo shoots were just beginning to sprout.
Xiaoqing still landed calmly and stood quietly, looking around the entire courtyard and nodded slightly without saying anything extra, but the aura around her body was obviously more relaxed than in the space.
